children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of the shaded region in the diagram. Give an exact answer and an approximation correct to 2 decimal places.

children.label: b
children.prompt: A third circle is drawn with the same centre as the other two circles. Find the radius of this circle if it cuts the shaded region into halves. Give an exact answer and an approximation correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
Let the third radius be $r$ cm. The inner half of the annulus has area $48\pi\text{ cm}^2$.
$$\begin{aligned}\pi(r^2-100)&=48\pi\\r^2&=148\\r&=\sqrt{148}\text{ cm}\approx12.17\text{ cm}.\end{aligned}$$
